entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I have an order... I think. I'm a bit lost. I got this package and it's not right.
I can certainly help you look into that. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or sizing issue?
Oh, um, sizing, I guess. It's a cycling jersey I ordered. I tried it on and it's just... wrong.
Okay, I understand. So you'd like to return the jersey?

Yes, I think so. It's just too tight. I thought I ordered the right one, but this feels like the wrong size completely. I tried to look on the website for what to do, but it was all very confusing. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can absolutely help you with that. It sounds like you just need to exchange it for a different size. Since you just received the jersey, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return policy for apparel. We can get a new one sent out to you.
Oh, really? It's that easy? That's a huge relief. I was worried I was stuck with it.

Not at all. We want to make sure you have gear that fits perfectly. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account right now. You can use that to send back the jersey that's too tight.
Okay, I see the email. That's great. So I just send this one back?
That's right. And what size would you like for the exchange? I can put the order in for you right now, and it will ship out as soon as the carrier scans your return package.
Could I get a Large, please? Thank you so much for making this simple.
You're very welcome. I've just processed the exchange for the jersey in a size Large. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help, David.
Happy to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
